verdict.rationale: Quick navigation to items by short name is a fair axis for a feedback and roadmap tool, so the story applies. The evidence pack covers widgets, SSO, integrations, the MCP server and a staging workspace, but nothing documents short identifiers or a jump-to or quick-search navigation feature. LLM querying via MCP and issue linking to Jira or Linear are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump directly to any feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name
